import Mathlib

#check mul_comm
#check add_le_add
#check sq_nonneg
#check abs_mul
#check two_mul
#check le_of_lt
#check lt_of_le_of_lt
#check Nat.Prime.two_le

mensajes.texto: mul_comm.{u_1} {G : Type u_1} [CommMagma G] (a b : G) : a * b = b * a

add_le_add.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} {a b c d : α} [Add α] [Preorder α] [AddLeftMono α] [AddRightMono α] (h₁ : a ≤ b)
  (h₂ : c ≤ d) : a + c ≤ b + d

sq_nonneg.{u} {R : Type u} [Semiring R] [LinearOrder R] [ExistsAddOfLE R] [PosMulMono R] [AddLeftMono R] (a : R) :
  0 ≤ a ^ 2
abs_mul.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Ring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedRing α] (a b : α) : |a * b| = |a| * |b|
two_mul.{u} {α : Type u} [NonAssocSemiring α] (n : α) : 2 * n = n + n
le_of_lt.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Preorder α] {a b : α} (hab : a < b) : a ≤ b
lt_of_le_of_lt.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [Preorder α] {a b c : α} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b < c) : a < c
